preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string s for each test case must be between 2 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'EN' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of characters 'E' and 'N'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a[i] == a[(i + 1) % len(s)] for i in range(len(s))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists an array a consistent with the string s, otherwise output 'NO'.
